entry.note: Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1090/memo/0612), OpenAlex table of contents, and primary citations in Porti (2015, arXiv:1511.00400v2) and Dubois (2005, arXiv:math/0403470v4).

relevance.rationale: Foundational monograph defining adjoint SL_2(C) Reidemeister torsion as a rational function on character varieties of cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds, including peripheral curve change-of-basis and Dehn-filling asymptotics consumed by QOU's 1-loop saddle-torsion program.

keyResults.statement: Constructs adjoint SL_2(C) Reidemeister torsion with respect to peripheral cusp curves and proves the change-of-curve Jacobian det(du_gamma1/du_gamma2) and hyperbolic Dehn-surgery limit.
keyResults.useForFolio: Pins peripheral-framing dependence (meridian vs longitude A-polynomial derivative factor) of adjoint torsion on 4_1, 5_2, and multi-cusp links.

proposedActions.rationale: Wired in prop:fivetwo-stokes-unimodular and audited in docs/audits/2026-11-28-torsion-reeb-stokes-evidence-and-relevancy.md.
